summary: Prepare PCIe all-reduce for three ranks and honor dependent-launch controls
models: Tensor-parallel models using B12X PCIe collectives
compatibility: PCIe one-shot and DMA all-reduce support TP3. DCP all-to-all retains its existing supported world sizes. PDL remains controlled by the existing B12X_PCIE_ONESHOT_PDL and B12X_MHC_PDL settings.
details: One-shot launches release dependent MHC work after the cross-rank barrier, and dependent MHC kernels wait before reading the reduced input.
